subject: Least-Privilege Audit: SCIM deltas, SAML traces & role snapshots
messages:
From: Lisa Kim <lisa.kim@everwellhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@everwellhealth.com
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — least-privilege audit follow-up

Jordan —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of our SIG v2 intake we need to validate a few items around your provisioning and SSO flows so our auditors can complete the least-privilege assessment. At a minimum we need:

- SCIM delta for the past 30 days (add/modify/deprovision events)
- A few SAML assertion samples showing authentication responses with attributes (nameid, groups, email)
- Current RBAC/role entitlement snapshot for the Everwell tenant (role -> permissions mapping)
- A short statement or attestation that automatic SCIM deprovisions occur within X minutes of SSO deactivation (approx expected time)

Can you provide the artifacts or point us to a secure location to pull them? Also let us know if you need a signed NDA or alternate transfer method.

Best,
Lisa Kim\Security & Risk\Everwell Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Kim <lisa.kim@everwellhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — least-privilege audit follow-up

Hi Lisa — thanks for the list and for the clear requirements. We can provide everything you requested. Proposed plan: 

1) Deliver a SCIM delta CSV export covering 2028-02-08 -> 2028-03-08 (UTC) with change type and timestamps.
2) Include 3 anonymized SAML assertion samples (redacted user ids) illustrating group attributes and nameid formats.
3) RBAC/role-entitlement CSV that maps Everwell roles to internal permissions (and a short readme on which permissions are safe/production-only).
4) A least-privilege attestation template completed by our Infosec team.

We will stage the package in a secure transfer link and share the Doc once the file package is ready. Do you prefer a single archive or separate files per artifact? Also confirming: the auditors will be looking for timelines on deprovision — we will provide measured averages plus the configuration that enforces immediate SCIM deprovision on account disable.

I'll loop in our provisioning SME (Marcus) and IAM owner (Grace) to gather artifacts.

—Jordan\Jordan Blake\Director, Customer Security Operations\Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Evidence request — least-privilege audit follow-up

Team — looping you in for artifact collection for Everwell Health (see thread below). Action items: 

- Marcus: export SCIM delta for the window 2028-02-08 -> 2028-03-08, include fields: id, username, op_type (create/update/delete), timestamp, source. Place CSV in /shared/compliance/everwell/ and mark the file scim-delta-20280228.csv.
- Grace: produce anonymized SAML assertion samples (3) that include group claims and nameid so auditors can validate claim mappings. Ensure PII is redacted but attributes preserved. Save as saml-assertions-sample.txt (include raw XML for each).
- Tessa: pull the RBAC snapshot (roles -> permissions) for Everwell tenant and run the role-to-privilege matrix. Save as role-entitlements-20280301.csv and include a short notes doc explaining any custom roles.

Deadline: EOD Tuesday (13 Mar) — we intend to package and send Wednesday morning to Everwell. Marcus, note auditors often ask for evidence that deprovisioning is deterministic — include a sample config snippet showing SCIM provisioning settings and a measured deprovision latency sample.

If any of this requires elevated access or export approvals, flag here and I will escalate to Prod Infra.

Thanks — Jordan\n

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 10:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Evidence request — least-privilege audit follow-up

Jordan / Marcus — status update: 

- SCIM delta export completed and dropped into the shared folder as scim-delta-20280228.csv (redacted audit ids). It contains creates, updates, deletes with source annotations.
- I generated three SAML assertion XML samples; user identifiers have been pseudonymized (user-###) and group claims preserved. File: saml-assertions-sample.txt (attached).
- Role snapshot ready: role-entitlements-20280301.csv. I added a short notes sheet describing which permissions are considered admin-only and which are safely delegable.
- Drafted a short attestation using our standard wording; file least-privilege-attestation-template.docx. Marcus — I left a placeholder for the measured deprovision latency; please populate with the measured average (we sampled 50 events).

If all looks good I can package into a password-protected zip and post to the secure-transfer link. Jordan — let me know if you want us to redline the attestation before sending.

Grace O'Connor\Senior IAM Engineer\Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Kim <lisa.kim@everwellhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — least-privilege audit follow-up

Lisa — attaching the evidence package for your SIG intake. Files provided: scim-delta-20280228.csv, saml-assertions-sample.txt, role-entitlements-20280301.csv, and our least-privilege attestation template (signed by Infosec pending Marcus's latency insertion).

Delivery notes: 
- Package posted to: https://secure-transfer.redwood.com/evw-package-4982 (password-protected; password shared via separate email to your security mailbox).
- SCIM deprovision behavior: our provisioner schedules immediate deprovision on account disable; measured median deprovision latency across the 50-event sample was 42 seconds, 95th percentile 3m12s (see latency_sample.csv inside the archive).
- The SAML samples are pseudonymized but retain claim structure. If auditors need unsubstituted samples for verification, we can arrange an NDA and an auditor-only view with redaction audit trail.

Next steps: confirm receipt and whether you'd like the artifacts bundled as one archive or separate per artifact. If your auditors want additional logging (assertion timestamps, assertion ID trace to login events), let us know and we will extend.

Thanks — Jordan\Director, Customer Security Operations\Redwood Inference

Attachments (referenced): scim-delta-20280228.csv (CSV stub), saml-assertions-sample.txt (3 XML samples), role-entitlements-20280301.csv, least-privilege-attestation-template.docx
